units.spine: Markets open here every day, and the custom that fills them comes in off the roads.
Soldiers here are paid to be soldiers, and no part of the town's safety falls to the townsfolk.
People here can afford to quarrel about something other than money.
The town is run on the expectation that it goes on being the town.
The walls and the citadel are sound work, and neither of them is for show.
Armed men enough to line the walls are kept here, and not one of them is new to the work.
Children here learn the rules about the dark before they learn much else, and the rules hold.
The watch answers where it is called and goes no further.
Prices here are steady, and no trade in the town is living on its last sale.
The mages' guild here does the work that is usually wanted and knows what is past it.
Rundgate is on the way to somewhere else and takes a modest living from the people passing through.
What the land here does not grow comes in by road.
The furrier's district and the warehouse district are both inside these walls, and a man may live in one and not know the other.
The ties this town keeps beyond its walls have been pressed and have not bent.
